drawn_reference_line._why: The authors drew this dashed rule and labelled it 'nominally high potency' without printing a coordinate; the text names 10^8 p/s as the threshold. It is therefore a round number external to this digitiser, and the whole calibration is wrong by exactly the offset recorded here.
